declaration.preface:
Royal Pharmaceuticals Industries Pvt. Ltd. recognizes its employees as the foundation of sustainable business success and is committed to providing a workplace that upholds dignity, respect, fairness, equality, and internationally recognized human rights. The Company integrates labour and human rights principles into its operations, business decisions, and employment practices through responsible leadership, employee engagement, legal compliance, and continual improvement.

The purpose of this Ethical Employment and Human Rights Policy is to establish a comprehensive framework for promoting ethical employment practices, protecting human rights, and fostering a safe, respectful, inclusive, and equitable workplace across all operations of Royal Pharmaceuticals Industries Pvt. Ltd. The policy aims to:

Promote fair, ethical, and responsible employment practices throughout the Company's operations.

Protect the fundamental human rights of all employees, workers, contractors, and individuals associated with the Company's activities.

Provide and maintain a safe, healthy, and secure workplace that minimizes occupational health and safety risks.

Promote equal employment opportunities and prevent discrimination, harassment, retaliation, and any form of workplace violence.

Eliminate child labour, forced labour, bonded labour, modern slavery, and human trafficking from all business operations and supply chain activities.

Ensure fair wages, benefits, working hours, leave entitlements, and employment conditions in accordance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Support employee learning, competency development, career progression, and leadership development through continuous training and professional development initiatives.
declaration.declaration: Royal Pharmaceuticals Industries Pvt. Ltd. is committed to upholding internationally recognized human rights and ethical employment practices across all its operations. The Company fosters a safe, inclusive, and respectful workplace free from discrimination, harassment, child labour, forced labour, and any form of unfair employment practice, while promoting equal opportunity, employee well-being, fair working conditions, and compliance with applicable legal and international labour standards.

Employee Health & Safety: We strive to provide and maintain a safe, healthy, and secure workplace by identifying, assessing, and controlling occupational health and safety risks across all business operations.
We will establish and maintain an Occupational Health and Safety Management System that supports legal compliance, operational excellence, and continual improvement in workplace safety performance.

We seek to prevent workplace injuries, occupational illnesses, unsafe conditions, and near-miss incidents through proactive hazard identification, risk assessments, engineering controls, safe work procedures, and preventive measures.

We will identify and control workplace health and safety risks through systematic risk assessments and preventive measures, and provide safe working conditions, appropriate PPE, emergency preparedness, and regular safety training to all relevant employees.

We will provide employees, contractors, and visitors with appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), safe machinery, emergency preparedness measures, and health protection programs relevant to their work activities.

We strive to strengthen employee participation in workplace safety through regular safety meetings, behavioural safety initiatives, hazard reporting, and consultation with employees and safety representatives.

We will promote physical and mental well-being by providing occupational health programs, wellness initiatives, health surveillance where applicable, stress management awareness, and access to appropriate support resources.
We seek to maintain emergency preparedness through periodic emergency response planning, fire safety measures, first aid facilities, evacuation drills, and incident response training.
Working Conditions: We strive to provide fair, respectful, and legally compliant working conditions that promote employee well-being, dignity, productivity, and job satisfaction across all business operations.

We will ensure that wages, benefits, working hours, overtime, rest periods, and leave entitlements are administered in accordance with applicable labour laws, industry standards, and Company policies.

We will provide fair, safe, and legally compliant working conditions, including fair wages, working hours, and employee benefits, and periodically review workplace conditions and welfare facilities to support employee well-being.
We seek to maintain a workplace where employment decisions are based on merit, competence, qualifications, and business requirements while ensuring fairness, transparency, and consistency.
We will provide employees with written terms and conditions of employment that clearly communicate their rights, responsibilities, compensation, benefits, and workplace expectations.

We strive to maintain clean, hygienic, secure, and well-maintained workplaces, including sanitation facilities, drinking water, rest areas, dining facilities, and welfare amenities to support employee comfort and well-being.
We will cover all of our employees in the regulatory insurance programme.
We will periodically review workplace practices and employment conditions to identify opportunities for continual improvement and enhance the overall employee experience.
Career Management & Training: We strive to provide equal opportunities for learning, skill enhancement, career progression, and professional development to enable employees to achieve their full potential while supporting the Company's long-term business objectives.

We will provide equal access to learning, skill development, and career advancement opportunities, and implement structured training, performance management, and succession planning to strengthen employee capability.

We will identify competency requirements across all functions and implement structured training, development, and succession planning initiatives to strengthen organizational capability and operational excellence.

We seek to foster a culture of continuous learning by providing technical, functional, behavioural, leadership, quality, health and safety, and compliance-related training programs aligned with business needs.

We will promote fair and transparent performance management processes that recognize employee contributions, encourage continuous feedback, and support career advancement based on merit, competency, and performance.

We strive to provide equal access to training and development opportunities regardless of gender, age, disability, religion, ethnicity, or any other protected characteristic, ensuring an inclusive learning environment.
We seek to identify and develop future leaders through succession planning, mentoring, coaching, and leadership development programs to ensure business continuity and organizational resilience.
Child Labor, Forced Labor & Human Traffi: We strive to uphold and protect internationally recognized human rights by maintaining zero tolerance for child labour, forced labour, bonded labour, compulsory labour, modern slavery, debt bondage, involuntary prison labour, and human trafficking throughout our operations and business relationships.

We will establish robust recruitment and employment practices to ensure that all employment is freely chosen, voluntary, and based on the informed consent of employees without coercion, intimidation, deception, or unlawful restrictions.

We seek to implement effective age verification and employment screening procedures during recruitment to prevent the employment of underage workers and ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and international standards.

We will prohibit the retention of employees' original identity documents, passports, personal certificates, wages, or other personal property as a condition of employment, except where required by law and with the employee's informed consent.

We strive to ensure that employees have the freedom to terminate their employment after providing the required notice in accordance with applicable laws and employment agreements without fear of retaliation, financial penalties, or coercion.

We will conduct appropriate due diligence and communicate our labour and human rights expectations to contractors, recruitment agencies, suppliers, and business partners to promote the elimination of child labour, forced labour, and human trafficking throughout the supply chain.

We seek to provide accessible and confidential grievance mechanisms that enable employees and other stakeholders to report suspected instances of child labour, forced labour, human trafficking, or unethical labour practices without fear of retaliation.
Discrimination, Harassment & Equal Oppor: We strive to foster a workplace culture built on respect, dignity, fairness, diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity, where every employee is treated with professionalism and without discrimination.

We will ensure that all employment-related decisions, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, promotion, training, career development, transfers, and termination, are based solely on merit, qualifications, competencies, performance, and business requirements.

We seek to prohibit discrimination, harassment, bullying, intimidation, retaliation, victimization, or any other inappropriate workplace behaviour based on gender, age, race, colour, religion, caste, nationality, ethnicity, disability, marital status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected under applicable laws.

We will maintain a workplace free from sexual harassment and other forms of workplace misconduct by implementing preventive measures, awareness programmes, confidential reporting channels, and fair investigation procedures in accordance with applicable legal requirements.

We strive to promote diversity and inclusion by encouraging equal participation, mutual respect, collaboration, and a workplace culture that values different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

We will provide employees with accessible, confidential, and impartial grievance mechanisms to report discrimination, harassment, retaliation, or any violation of this Policy without fear of reprisal.
Employee Well-being & Work-Life Balance: We strive to foster a workplace that promotes the physical, mental, emotional, and social well-being of employees by creating a supportive, healthy, and inclusive working environment.

We will encourage a healthy work-life balance by implementing fair working schedules, appropriate leave provisions, flexible workplace practices where operationally feasible, and initiatives that support employee well-being and productivity.

We seek to promote employee wellness through preventive healthcare initiatives, health awareness programs, periodic medical examinations, fitness activities, counselling support, and wellness campaigns.

We will cultivate a positive workplace culture that encourages mutual respect, teamwork, employee engagement, open communication, and recognition of employee contributions while supporting psychological well-being.
We strive to minimize workplace stress and fatigue by promoting responsible workload management, adequate rest periods, effective resource planning, and employee support programs.

We will encourage employees to actively participate in wellness initiatives, recreational activities, awareness campaigns, and engagement programs that strengthen morale, collaboration, and organizational commitment.

We seek to provide employees with access to appropriate welfare facilities, including hygienic sanitation, safe drinking water, rest areas, dining facilities, first-aid services, and other amenities that contribute to their overall well-being.
Freedom of Association, Employee Engagem: We strive to respect employees' rights to freedom of association and collective dialogue, in accordance with applicable labour laws and internationally recognized human rights principles, while fostering a culture of mutual trust and collaboration.

We will promote open, transparent, and constructive communication between employees and management by encouraging regular consultation, feedback, and active employee participation in workplace matters that affect their health, safety, well-being, and working conditions.

We seek to establish and maintain fair, accessible, confidential, and transparent grievance mechanisms that enable employees to raise workplace concerns, complaints, or suggestions without fear of intimidation, discrimination, retaliation, or adverse consequences.

We will encourage employee engagement through regular meetings, suggestion schemes, surveys, awareness programmes, committees, and continuous dialogue to strengthen employee involvement in organizational improvement initiatives.
We strive to ensure that all employee grievances are handled impartially, confidentially, and promptly through documented procedures that promote fairness, accountability, and timely resolution.

We will communicate grievance procedures, employee rights, and reporting channels to all employees, contractors, and relevant stakeholders to ensure awareness and accessibility across the organization.

We seek to strengthen workplace relationships by encouraging collaboration, mutual respect, and shared responsibility between employees, supervisors, and management to create a positive and productive work environment.

responsibilities.duty: The Managing Director is responsible for approving the Ethical Employment and Human Rights Policy and providing strategic direction for ethical labour practices and human rights protection. The Managing Director shall demonstrate leadership and commitment towards creating a safe, fair, inclusive, and respectful workplace, ensure the availability of adequate financial, human, and technical resources for effective implementation of the Policy, and periodically review labour and human rights performance, strategic objectives, and improvement initiatives.

Department Heads are responsible for implementing the Ethical Employment and Human Rights Policy within their respective departments. They shall promote a respectful, safe, and inclusive workplace culture, ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, Company policies, and human rights commitments, identify labour and human rights risks, implement corrective and preventive actions where necessary, and encourage employee participation, engagement, and continual improvement.

The Human Resources (HR) Department shall coordinate the implementation, communication, and periodic review of the Ethical Employment and Human Rights Policy. HR is responsible for developing labour and human rights objectives, programmes, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring fair recruitment, onboarding, compensation, performance management, training, career development, and employee welfare practices.

The EHS Department shall support the implementation of occupational health and safety programs aligned with this Policy. Responsibilities include conducting workplace risk assessments, safety inspections, emergency preparedness activities, and occupational health initiatives, monitoring workplace incidents, occupational illnesses, and corrective actions, and providing technical guidance on employee health, safety, and well-being programs.

Supervisors and Managers are responsible for ensuring that employees understand and comply with the requirements of this Policy. They shall promote fair treatment, equal opportunity, and respectful workplace behaviour, address employee concerns promptly and escalate grievances where appropriate, encourage participation in training, development, health, safety, and engagement programs, and monitor workplace conditions while promptly reporting any labour or human rights concerns.

All employees are responsible for complying with this Ethical Employment and Human Rights Policy and all applicable Company procedures. Employees shall treat colleagues, contractors, visitors, and stakeholders with dignity, respect, fairness, and professionalism, follow workplace health and safety requirements, participate in training and awareness programs, report unsafe conditions, discrimination, harassment, unethical practices, or human rights concerns through established reporting channels, and contribute to maintaining a safe, inclusive, respectful, and ethical workplace culture through responsible behaviour and continual improvement initiatives.

policy.monitoring:
Royal Pharmaceuticals Industries Pvt. Ltd. shall regularly monitor, measure, and evaluate its labour and human rights performance to ensure compliance with this Policy.

Labour and human rights performance shall be monitored through the following activities:

Monitoring of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) against established labour and human rights objectives and targets.

Periodic monitoring of occupational health and safety performance, employee well-being, working conditions, training and competency development, employee engagement, and workplace culture.

Regular workplace inspections, labour compliance assessments, health and safety audits, and human rights due diligence activities to identify risks and improvement opportunities.

Monitoring and evaluation of employee grievances, workplace complaints, discrimination and harassment cases, corrective actions, and grievance resolution timelines to assess the effectiveness of grievance management processes.

Periodic review of employee training, competency development programmes, diversity and inclusion initiatives, wellness programmes, and employee engagement activities to measure their effectiveness and support continual improvement.

Royal Pharmaceuticals Industries Pvt. Ltd. shall provide periodic training and awareness programs on labour rights, human rights, workplace ethics, occupational health and safety, diversity and inclusion, grievance mechanisms, and applicable legal requirements. Specialized training shall be provided to relevant personnel based on their roles and responsibilities to support effective implementation of this Policy.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The Ethical Employment and Human Rights Policy shall be reviewed at least annually, or earlier if required by HR Head due to changes in legal requirements, business operations, or organizational needs. The review and any revisions shall be approved by the Managing Director or the designated management representative before implementation.

Next Review Date: 01st April 2027
